packages.comment: Not part of any binary: files that travel beside certdoctor-gui in its archive for windows/amd64, in a folder called opengl, which it loads to draw when the graphics driver offers no OpenGL. As the notices list them: opengl/libgallium_wgl.dll, 61880320 bytes, SHA-256 700e1fb7b9487d9d1c53752b03aeb040d22f3731b46aa254d88830b6279474de; opengl/opengl32.dll, 139264 bytes, SHA-256 c8511461ba71a0288750467e3be2f5c1c2bbbceaaf0ab5d8c496b0ba7302daa8. These are the files as the release they come from holds them. A release signs them, and a signed copy is longer and has another sum.
